identity_and_concept.title: Tanda - Premium iOS Light Calendar Marking Web App
identity_and_concept.tagline: Mark your days with precision and elegance
identity_and_concept.storage: FastAPI + MongoDB backend with real-time server synchronization

interactive_components.add_marker_sheet: Bottom sheet modal using Shadcn Sheet / Framer motion slide-up drawer with handle bar, color picker grid (13 iOS colors), icon picker (SF symbols like check-circle, lightning, x-mark, star, heart, bell, flame, cart, dollar, key, gift, tag, flag), date picker / auto-selected date, and customary custom label tag input.
interactive_components.search_drawer: Floating overlay or bottom sheet with instant real-time filtering across all marked dates, label titles, colors, and notes, complete with jump-to-date calendar focus.
interactive_components.agenda_list_view: Toggleable timeline list showing all marked events chronologically grouped by month with search and multi-delete options.
interactive_components.year_picker_modal: Full grid selector of 12 months for rapid jump across past & future years (2020 - 2030+).

motion_and_micro_interactions.on_load: Masked line-by-line month title reveal with spring physics (stiffness 300, damping 25)
motion_and_micro_interactions.marker_pop: Spring scale animation on mark creation/toggle (scale from 0.4 -> 1.15 -> 1.0)
motion_and_micro_interactions.month_swipe: Horizontal drag gesture switch with spring snaps (drag='x' dragConstraints={{ left: 0, right: 0 }})
motion_and_micro_interactions.marquee: Continuous slow editorial smooth drift of upcoming marked events

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to light mode iOS styling ('Terang') with pure white cards, #FAFAFB base, and thin hairline borders.
Ensure max-width constraint (430px) is applied so the app renders as a sleek mobile frame centered on desktop browsers.
Implement full FastAPI backend CRUD API endpoints under /api/markers for storing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting marker items in MongoDB.
Include Indonesian text for all user-facing UI strings (e.g., 'Januari', 'Minggu', 'Senin', 'Lunas', 'Token Listrik', 'Belum Lunas', 'Tambah Catatan', 'Cari Catatan', 'Pilih Warna').
Support multiple markers per single date with overlapping indicator badges or stacked circles.
Ensure all buttons and interactive elements have data-testid attributes for automated testing.
